# apple_game_center_achievement (Resource)

Creates a Game Center achievement for an app, or for a group of apps. Add its name and descriptions with `apple_game_center_achievement_localization` and its image with `apple_game_center_achievement_image`, then submit it with `apple_submit_game_center_achievement`. Destroying the resource deletes the achievement; one that has been live can't be deleted, so it is archived instead. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_achievement" "first_win" {
  game_center_detail_id = apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  reference_name        = "First win"
  vendor_identifier     = "com.example.first_win"
  points                = 10
  show_before_earned    = true
  repeatable            = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `points` (Number) Points the achievement is worth, 1 to 100. An app's achievements can total 1,000 points.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the achievement in App Store Connect.
- `repeatable` (Boolean) Whether players can earn the achievement more than once.
- `show_before_earned` (Boolean) Whether players see the achievement before they earn it.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier the game reports the achievement with, e.g. `com.example.first_win`. Changing it creates a new achievement.

### Optional

- `activity_properties` (Map of String) Properties passed to the game when the achievement is opened from a Game Center activity.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the achievement is archived, which hides it from players. Defaults to `false`.
- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center detail, e.g. `apple_game_center_detail.example.id`. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group, for an achievement its apps share. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center achievement.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_achievement.first_win
  identity = {
    id = "9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center achievement.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_achievement.first_win 9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e
```
